metadata.description:
This upload compiles the complete run of the Emmy-winning Mainframe Entertainment/Hasbro venture "Beast Wars: Transformers" just in time for the series' 25th anniversary. All 3 seasons have been upscaled with AI to a sharp 1080p by reddit's u/Straken1 ("Al's" on YouTube), also viewable collected in their native playlist here. The results are very impressive, no doubt at least in part due to the crisp/flat early CG rendering inherent to the source material— it was TV's second-ever fully 3D animated cartoon, made by the same people behind "Reboot" (the first-ever).

I did not create the original series, nor this remastered version; I simply mirror the files here for archival purposes. The files, mostly .mkv with some .mp4, were obtained through youtube-dlg & remain unmodified other than slight renaming for organization.
